data_fields.name: max_voices
data_fields.donor_constant: none (uncapped; proposed 8 in sketch, not donor data)

best_idea: Mix every overlapping one-shot cue into one output buffer at equal-power gain 1/sqrt(N) so simultaneous hits do not clip, and drop cues instead of queuing them when nothing consumes them.
decision_why: Overlap gain and drop-when-no-consumer fit many-on-one hit cues; the donor lacks a voice cap and a gain ramp, so both are added; the Qt backend choice and the WinMM path are platform plumbing and are rejected.
acceptance: A client-only test starts three full-scale hit cues in one window and asserts the output stays inside the 16-bit range at gain 1/sqrt(3); ending one cue mid-buffer ramps the gain across the buffer; a ninth cue in the same window is refused and not queued.
